propositions: Multiple per-extra matrix jobs fan out into 6 concurrent slots, exceeding GitHub Free org limits (20 total, 5 macOS) and causing 21m runs to extend to 41-47m under queue contention.

Current matrix runs {agents, eval, tracing, mcp, grounding} but _optional.EXTRAS only contains {agents, eval, grounding, metrics, tracing}, leaving metrics untested per-extra and treating mcp (which has no detection probe) incorrectly.

The per-extra and union jobs must be collapsed into a single looped job running 7 iterations (6 isolation + 1 union) without stacking venv activations or using bare console-script calls that could silently re-test the wrong interpreter.
Error isolation requires an rc accumulator with explicit continue and exit mechanics to prevent silent failures or losing today's fail-fast: false diagnostics.
Checked-in tests must guard against reintroduction of the activate/bare-call footguns and verify every _optional.EXTRAS key is covered in the loop.
